name: net.oshawalimo/booking
title: OshawaLimo.net
description: Oshawa and Durham Region black car and limo service: packages, fares and ride requests.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Find OshawaLimo.net pages for an airport (YYZ, YTZ, YOO...), city or town (Whitby, Ajax, Bowmanville...), venue, team, event, hotel, route, package, service or travel topic. Returns titles, summaries and URLs with Markdown versions.

section.description: Optional first path segment filter, e.g. airports, cities, packages, routes, services, events, attractions, hotels, blog

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Return the Markdown text of an OshawaLimo.net page: pickup points, drive times, fares, tips and FAQ. Accepts a full URL or a path such as /airports/toronto-pearson-yyz/.

tools.name: get_booking_options
tools.description: Services, vehicle classes, coverage, what every fixed fare includes, waiting and cancellation rules, contact channels and the booking page link.

tools.name: get_packages
tools.description: Fixed-price round-trip packages from Oshawa (Toronto, Niagara Falls, airports and more) by vehicle class, with the total including 13% HST and the secure Stripe pay link the traveller can open to pay. Never pay on the traveller's behalf.

tools.name: get_fares
tools.description: Planning fare ranges (CAD, before HST) from downtown Oshawa to airports, cities and venues by vehicle class, plus hourly rates. The exact fixed fare is quoted by the reservation engine or the desk.

tools.name: request_booking
tools.description: Send a chauffeured ride request to the OshawaLimo.net 24/7 dispatch desk for the traveller. Only call when the traveller explicitly asked to book. Returns a reference (OSH-XXXXXXX); the desk then confirms the fixed fare, vehicle and chauffeur by email or phone. No payment is taken; it is not a confirmed booking until the desk confirms.

package.description: Package slug from get_packages, if booking a round-trip package

pickup.description: Full address, hotel, venue, or airport code + terminal

time.description: Local pickup time HH:MM (for arrivals, the scheduled landing time)

return.description: Return trip date, time and address, if any

notes.description: Child seats, accessibility, meet and greet sign name, stops, etc.

agent.description: Name of your assistant or app

consent.description: The traveller explicitly asked for this booking
